newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher on institutional buying.

text.p: Delhi shares closed higher on Tuesday, buoyed by heavy buying in select blue-chip companies by speculators and domestic financial institutions, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 8.47 points higher at 727.02.
Brokers said the government's presentation of the annual Economic Survey for 1996/97 (April-March) failed to make a significant impact on share prices.
"The activity was only speculative in nature and was confined to only a few companies," said Ashok Arya of brokers S.C. Gupta and Company.
Reliance Industries rose 6.30 rupees to 263.75 on sustained buying by institutional investors and speculators, brokers said.
State Bank of India closed 0.50 rupee higher at 276.30.
ITC bucked the trend to close 3.65 rupees lower at 392.65.
